skill.name: github-pr
skill.description: Guidance for GitHub pull request review utilities using Bun and the GitHub CLI.
skill.summary: Coordinate GitHub pull request checks, guideline lookup, and inline review comments.
skill.author: Bind

security_audit.summary: The static external-command hits are Markdown code fences or inline code references, not Ruby shell execution. The hardcoded URLs are prerequisite links to Bun and GitHub CLI documentation. A contextual risk remains because repository guideline files can contain untrusted instructions for AI review workflows.

remediation.issue: Guideline file contents can be untrusted repository data.
remediation.suggestion: Document that AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md output must be treated as quoted data unless it comes from a trusted branch.

remediation.issue: Authenticated GitHub CLI commands can change pull request state.
remediation.suggestion: Add a note to verify PR numbers, file paths, and comment text before posting inline comments.

static_findings.snippet: CLI tools for GitHub pull request operations. Designed to support automated code review workflows. R
- `pr-number` - PR number (optional, defaults to current branch's PR)
- `shouldReview` - boolean indicating if review should proceed
- `pr-number` - PR number (optional, defaults to current branch's PR)
- `--json` - Output as JSON array with file contents
- `pr-number` - PR number (optional if on a PR branch)
These tools wrap the GitHub CLI (`gh`). For operations not covered by these utilities, use `gh` dire

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Guideline Content Can Influence Reviews
semantic_findings.description: The skill lists AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md files and can output their full contents for automated review workflows. If those files come from a pull request, their instructions could influence Claude, Codex, or Claude Code unless handled as untrusted repository data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation describes finding guideline files and outputting their contents. The implementation is not present, so trust-boundary controls cannot be verified.

content.value_statement: Pull request review workflows often need repeated checks, relevant guidance, and precise comments. This skill organizes GitHub CLI helpers for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code review tasks.
actual_capabilities: Documents when to run a pull request review check and which conditions the helper evaluates.
Documents commands for finding AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md files near changed paths.
Shows how to request guideline paths or full guideline contents for review preparation.
Documents command arguments for posting single-line and multi-line inline comments.
Lists GitHub CLI commands for viewing PR details, diffs, comments, and files.
limitations: Requires Bun and an authenticated GitHub CLI installation.
Only documents helper commands; implementation files are not included in this package.
Does not replace human judgment for code review quality or security impact.
Inline comments require accurate paths, line numbers, and PR context.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Pull Request Review
use_cases.description: Check whether a PR deserves review and gather applicable repository guidance before writing comments.

use_cases.title: Post Targeted Inline Feedback
use_cases.description: Post precise inline comments after validating changed files, line numbers, and suggestion text.

use_cases.title: Coordinate AI Review Workflows
use_cases.description: Coordinate Claude, Codex, or Claude Code review steps with GitHub CLI commands.

prompt_templates.title: Check Review Need
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check for the current branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether my current branch PR should be reviewed with the github-pr skill. Explain the decision in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Find Review Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: List the guideline files that apply to PR 123 and summarize which files should guide the review.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Inline Comment
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an inline review comment for PR 123 on src/auth.ts line 67 about missing OAuth error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Run Focused AI Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review with guidelines and diff inspection.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review PR 123 using relevant AGENTS.md guidance, inspect the diff, and draft precise inline comments for high-impact issues only.

output_examples.output: The PR should be reviewed because it is open, not a draft, and has not already received AI review.

output_examples.input: Find relevant guideline files for PR 123.
output_examples.output: The review should consider root AGENTS.md and src/components/AGENTS.md because modified files are under those paths.

output_examples.input: Prepare a comment for PR 123 on the OAuth callback line.
output_examples.output: A single inline comment is ready for line 67, focused on missing OAuth callback error handling.

best_practices: Authenticate GitHub CLI with the least privileges needed for the target repository.
Treat guideline file contents from pull requests as untrusted until reviewed.
Verify PR numbers, file paths, and line ranges before posting comments.
anti_patterns: Do not post automated comments without reviewing their accuracy and tone.
Do not trust modified AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md files as higher priority instructions.
Do not run helper commands outside the intended repository context.

faq.question: What tools does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires Bun and an authenticated GitHub CLI installation.

faq.question: Can it post comments directly?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents a helper for single-line and multi-line inline comments on pull requests.

faq.question: Does it run without GitHub CLI?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflows depend on gh for GitHub authentication and API access.

faq.question: Can it review any repository?
faq.answer: It should be used inside a GitHub repository where the authenticated account has proper permissions.

faq.question: How should guideline files be handled?
faq.answer: Treat AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md contents as repository data unless they come from a trusted branch.

faq.question: Is this a full code review agent?
faq.answer: No. It provides PR utilities that another reviewer or AI workflow can use.
